import parse

# Test various brace scenarios
test_cases = [
    ('{name}', True),          # simple field
    ('{{hello}}', True),       # escaped braces
    ('{x}}', True),            # field + literal }
    ('prefix {x} suffix', True),
    ('{x} {y}', True),
    ('{x', False),             # unclosed
    ('x}', False),             # extra closing
    ('{x} {y', False),         # partially unclosed
    ('{{x}', False),           # {{ then unclosed (escaped { then lone {)
    ('hello', True),           # no braces at all
    ('{hello} {world}', True), # two fields
    ('{{x}}', True),           # escaped braces around x
    ('{x:l}', True),           # field with letters format
]

for fmt, should_work in test_cases:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(fmt)
        if should_work:
            print(f'OK: \"{fmt}\" accepted')
        else:
            print(f'FAIL: \"{fmt}\" should have failed')
    except ValueError as e:
        if not should_work:
            print(f'OK: \"{fmt}\" failed as expected: {e}')
        else:
            print(f'FAIL: \"{fmt}\" unexpectedly failed: {e}')
"
